findings.b: The Ahmad story reel got 1,203 views and 116 likes. That is 3.7x your usual and twice the likes of any other reel here. There was no episode 2.
The TRAPO Holiday Scentscape and PROTON Tech Showcase reels got 131 and 222 views, both below your usual of 327.
Your 9 latest reels ran from 18 Nov to 17 Feb. Since then you have posted 2 carousels, on 1 May and 12 Sep, and no reels.

fixFirst: Turn the Ahmad story into a weekly reel series and post episode 2 this week.
fixThen: Keep brand event visits for Stories unless the brand pays for the reach.
Always write the first line of the caption. Your one reel without a caption is among your 3 weakest.
target: 4 Ahmad story episodes in 30 days. Median up from {median} to 600 views.
